text:
I built a Grok @bot called Pain in the Task.

https://x.ai/bot/yztAMds3EQ2J5OjG_tBgw

You give it something you do on repeat that you hate, procrastinate on, or wish you could hand off. It interviews you (not a form), diagnoses the actual workflow, and prescribes the right kind of help.

Sometimes that’s a reusable skill. Sometimes a routine. Sometimes it stands up another bot whose whole job is that work, and that bot can collaborate with you instead of dumping a prompt in your lap.

It trains on a real example before it automates. Don’t skip from pain to a cron job.

I used it on my weekly grocery restock. It created Restock, which pings me for the household list, builds a pickup cart from what I usually buy, and stops before it pays. I review, then I schedule.

Other things you could run through it: weekly client updates, turning a call into a follow-up and a next-step list, expense receipts you’ve been avoiding, the inbox you keep meaning to clear, prep for a meeting or workshop you run over and over.

Try it and tell me what you think.

👊🏻
